decisions.rationale: Rubble-stone house, 7 x 10 m, eaves 4.1 m, slate roof at 48 degrees to a 9.3 m chimney, one 1.3 x 2.8 m plank door (the 2.25 m soldier clears it by 0.55 m), shuttered windows and a gable window; 498 triangles, 43,504 bytes before meshopt. Walls stay inside the oriented-box collider below 3 m and eaves overhang at most 0.78 m above it (check-kit: OK); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: Walls are one flat rubble layer: no quoins, sills or lintels proud of the face, so the silhouette is a clean box.
The slate roof is a single plane per side with no ridge tiles or moss build-up.
Surfaces are tiled 2 m layers shared by the whole kit; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decals per building.

decisions.rationale: In Saltmarket, Wreckers' Rest, Cinderwell, Crownbridge, High Pass and Star Monastery at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss; shadows ground it on the relief; the 1.6-3.2 m architecture cutaway keeps the hero visible behind it, and a camera inside its bounds (plus 2 m) hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Not enterable: interiors are not modelled.
Lighting is the overcast day grade only; windows never light up.
